_doc: Words with a numeral or a digit that write a fixed term, a unit, a rate's base, an age or a scale label, never a number (next_flow::number_free, next_tree::number_free). Built by tools from source metadata only, no word typed in by hand: World Bank indicator names in Chinese (api.worldbank.org/v2/zh/indicator, sha256 385436f8d4f5f406, 29533 rows) and the unit table unit-short-zh.tsv (one row per Eurostat/World Bank unit code). terms: coded names in indicator names (PM2.5), blanked unless a numeral, a quantity word or a placeholder comes right before; si_units: blanked after a placeholder too, never after a numeral or a quantity word; rates: a rate's base taken literally (每千人; 每三人 is not here and stays a number); ages: an age or an age band taken literally, a range mark (- – — 至 到) read as '-'; scales: a scale label, blanked only inside brackets (（百万吨）). A count of places (四国) is not here: it is checked against the places the page draws.
